SELECT driver_id, driver_handle, auth_method FROM (
  SELECT d.id AS driver_id, d.handle AS driver_handle, 'per_driver'::text AS auth_method
  FROM drivers d
  WHERE d.is_active = true AND d.ping_secret = $1::text
  LIMIT 1
) resolved
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::text, 'unauthorized'::text
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM drivers d
  WHERE d.is_active = true AND d.ping_secret = $1::text
);

-- v4: uses resolved_driver_id from upstream (no more 'WHERE role=owner').
INSERT INTO location_pings (driver_id, lat, lng, source, ts)
SELECT $1::bigint, $2::double precision, $3::double precision, $4::text, to_timestamp($5::bigint)
WHERE $6::int = 200 AND $1::bigint IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (driver_id, date_trunc('minute', (ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) DO NOTHING;

-- v4: filter by driver_handle if provided; default to owner. Always one row.
-- $1 = driver_handle or sentinel '__none__' (n8n drops empty-string params, so caller must send a sentinel).
WITH found AS (
  SELECT vp.driver_id, vp.lat, vp.lng, vp.source, vp.ts, vp.age_seconds,
         d.handle AS driver_handle
  FROM v_latest_ping vp
  JOIN drivers d ON d.id = vp.driver_id
  WHERE d.is_active = true
    AND CASE
      WHEN $1::text <> '__none__' THEN d.handle = $1::text
      ELSE d.role = 'owner'
    END
  ORDER BY vp.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM found
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::double precision, NULL::double precision, NULL::text,
       NULL::timestamptz, NULL::integer, NULL::text
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found);

INSERT INTO eta_snapshots (
  driver_id, origin_lat, origin_lng, dest_text, dest_resolved,
  eta_seconds, distance_m, buffer_minutes,
  internal_eta_at, client_eta_at,
  location_age_seconds, location_stale, raw_response
)
VALUES (
  $1::bigint, $2::double precision, $3::double precision, $4::text, $5::text,
  $6::int, $7::int, $8::int,
  to_timestamp($9::bigint), to_timestamp($10::bigint),
  $11::int, $12::boolean, $13::jsonb
)
RETURNING id;

-- v4: filter by driver_handle from webhook payload; default to owner. Always one row.
-- $1 = driver_handle or sentinel '__none__' (n8n drops empty-string params, so caller must send a sentinel).
WITH found AS (
  SELECT vp.driver_id, vp.lat, vp.lng, vp.ts, vp.age_seconds, d.handle AS driver_handle
  FROM v_latest_ping vp
  JOIN drivers d ON d.id = vp.driver_id
  WHERE d.is_active = true
    AND CASE
      WHEN $1::text <> '__none__' THEN d.handle = $1::text
      ELSE d.role = 'owner'
    END
  ORDER BY vp.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM found
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::double precision, NULL::double precision,
       NULL::timestamptz, NULL::integer, NULL::text
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found);

-- Optional trip_id/client_id arrive as '__none__' sentinel when JS-null, because n8n stringifies null to the literal text 'null' which breaks ::bigint cast.
INSERT INTO client_area_snapshots (
  driver_id, order_id, client_id, center_lat, center_lng, radius_m,
  precision_label, expires_at, map_url
)
VALUES (
  $1::bigint,
  NULLIF($2::text, '__none__')::bigint,
  NULLIF($3::text, '__none__')::bigint,
  $4::double precision, $5::double precision,
  $6::int, $7::text, $8::timestamptz, $9::text
)
ON CONFLICT (driver_id, radius_m, date_trunc('hour', (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')))
DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
